effect.minecraft.absorption.description: Adds temporary health that absorbs incoming damage and can't be regenerated. You feel some sort of forcefield around you
effect.minecraft.speed.description: Increases movement speed on land. Gotta go fast
effect.minecraft.conduit_power.descripti: Increases underwater visibility and mining speed, prevents drowning. Did bro just become a mermaid?
effect.minecraft.dolphins_grace.descript: Increases swimming speed. Guess you're submarine now.. BRRRRRRRRRR!!11
effect.minecraft.slowness.description: Decreases walking speed. Being slow like a snail is not a cool feeling i guess
effect.minecraft.haste.description: Increases mining and attack speed. Your hands feel light as feather
effect.minecraft.health_boost.descriptio: Increases maximum health. You feel tanky
effect.minecraft.mining_fatigue.descript: Decreases mining and attack speed. You feel like your hands are heavy and it's difficult to move them
effect.minecraft.strength.description: Increases melee damage dealt to all entities. You feel strong!
effect.minecraft.resistance.description: Reduces damage taken by 20% per 1 effect level. Is that me or is your skin now made out steel?
effect.minecraft.hunger.description: Increases food exhaustion. You feel your stomach emptying every passing second
effect.minecraft.saturation.description: Restores hunger and saturation points. Now you feed on air and the energy of the sun
effect.minecraft.weakness.description: Decreases melee damage dealt to all entities. Y-you feal.. wea- *sneeze
effect.minecraft.poison.description: Inflicts damage over time unless the entity's health is at 1 point. Don't drink mercury next time i guess??
effect.minecraft.wither.description: Inflicts damage over time. Death is inevitable without medical assistance if the effect lasts a long time and HP is low
effect.minecraft.levitation.description: Floats the affected entity upward. Where the hell did gravitation go?!!
effect.minecraft.luck.description: Increases chances of better loot from fishing. I'm feeling lucky
effect.minecraft.unluck.description: Reduces chances of better loot from fishing. What a loser.
effect.minecraft.bad_omen.description: Causes an ominous event upon entering a village or a trial chamber. You feel weird evil aura around you.
effect.minecraft.raid_omen.description: Starts a raid at the location the player gained the Raid Omen in villages, once the effect expires. You feel someone's eyes on your back..
effect.minecraft.darkness.description: Adds a pulsating darkening affect to the player's screen and pulsating black fog. Next time, don't get up so abruptly.
effect.minecraft.nausea.description: Wobbles and warps the player's screen. DEAR GOD, WHAT THE FUCK DID I JUST ATE??
effect.minecraft.water_breathing.descrip: Prevents drowning and lets the affected entity breathe underwater.
effect.minecraft.invisibility.descriptio: Makes the affected entity invisible (but not the item they hold or the armor they wear), and reduces other mobs' detection range for the affected entity. Save the world my final message, goodbye ✌
effect.minecraft.blindness.description: Impairs vision by adding close black fog and disables the ability to sprint and critical hit.
effect.minecraft.night_vision.descriptio: Lets the player see well in darkness and underwater. Cats eyes, &m9 lives
effect.minecraft.glowing.description: Affected entity gets an outline that can be seen through blocks
effect.minecraft.slow_falling.descriptio: Decreases falling speed, negates fall damage and disables mace smashing as a side effect
effect.minecraft.trial_omen.description: Transforms nearby trial spawners into ominous trial spawners, spawning stronger mobs with armor
effect.minecraft.wind_charged.descriptio: Affected entities emit a burst of wind upon death. fart
effect.minecraft.weaving.description: Lessens the movement speed decrease from being in a cobweb by 25%, and causes cobwebs to be spread upon death
effect.minecraft.oozing.description: Makes the entity spawn 2 slimes upon death
effect.minecraft.infested.description: Gives the entity a 10% chance to spawn between 1 and 3 silverfish when hurt
effect.minecraft.fire_resistance.descrip: Prevents the affected entity from taking all fire/lava damage
effect.minecraft.hero_of_the_village.des: Gives discounts on trades with villagers, and makes villagers throw items at the player depending on their profession. You like farming totems and discounts, don't you?
effect.minecraft.regeneration.descriptio: Restores health over time. Your wounds heal right before our eyes!
effect.minecraft.jump_boost.description: Increases jump height and reduces fall damage. [insert random bunny joke here]
moodles.configuration.displayMode.toolti:
POTENCY - effects that don't scale with potency have square frames, vice versa.

CAS:UNKNOWN - square frames for positive, circle for neutral and negative.
